reason: Every measured claim reproduces. Structural claim first: driving all twelve configured states at 1280x900 without interaction, .b-undo is absent from the DOM in ten of them, display:none in owner-flight, and visibility:hidden (data-empty="true", via b.css:831) in owner-editing. audit.mjs gates its type/tracking scan on `visible` (display!=="none" && visibility!=="hidden", audit.mjs:200/247) and its hit-target scan on `interactive && visible` (audit.mjs:372), so .b-undoAct and .b-undo kbd have literally never entered the measured perimeter. This is not a restatement of a gate; it is the complement of one. (a) Hit target, verified: Playwright context at 390x844 with isMobile/hasTouch so matchMedia("(pointer: coarse)") returns true, undo bar filled by clicking .b-step[data-delta="1"] — .b-undoAct renders 51.3x28, computed min-height 28px, no negative-inset pseudo (grow=0). b.css:1336 lists .b-act, .b-seg button, .b-step, .b-grab, .b-linkField and does omit .b-undoAct, so the one control that takes a change back sits 16px under the floor the file's own comment at b.css:1332 declares. Note the audit's own target floor is 28, not 44, so even a visible bar would have passed at exactly 28 — the 44px rule is the file's, and the file breaks it. (b) Letterfit, verified: kbd computes "Geist Mono" 11px, text-transform none, letter-spacing 1.76px (--track-label, 0.16em, whose own token comment at shell.css:55 reads "uppercase mono micro-labels" — and kbd is sentence case "Ctrl Z"). .b-date computes the same family and size, text-transform none, 0.44px. Re-deriving audit.mjs:340-343's roleT on the live nodes: kbd is not a control, is not uppercase mono, size<20 -> role "body"; .b-date -> "body". Identical trackKey "Geist Mono...|11|body" at two letterfits, which is exactly what audit.mjs:346-350 pushes as a tracking violation. I swept every visible mono-11px text node in owner-editing at 390: fourteen sentence-case elements (.b-date x8, .b-unit, .b-where, .b-origin, .b-grabWord, .b-keeper, .b-foot span) all render 0.44px, and every 1.76px element is uppercase (.b-label, .b-measureHead, .b-todayLabel, .b-behindLabel) — kbd is the single sentence-case string in the product at the uppercase letterfit. Round-6's fix moved its six neighbours across and left it behind. Real, specific, and on the primary safety net. One caution the finding did not catch, folded into the sharpened fix: the proposed 44px addition as written breaks the editor at 390. Applied, the .b-edit undo bar grows 64.4px -> 80.4px and its bottom hairline lands 97.4px below the panel top while .b-edit's padding-top is the hand-measured 88px (b.css:822) and the first .b-label sits at 89px — screenshot confirms the bar covers "WHAT IT IS". The padding must move with it.
sharpenedFix: Three edits, all lab-local; do not touch the shared audit.mjs. (1) b.css:1336 — add .b-undoAct to the coarse list. (2) In the same @media (pointer: coarse) block, add `.b-edit { padding-top: 104px; }` — the bar's measured bottom goes 81.4 -> 97.4px when the button reaches 44, so the 88px hand-measured offset at b.css:822 must move with it or the bar's hairline crosses the first field label at 390 (verified by screenshot). Re-measure and comment the new number the way b.css:820-822 comments the old one. (3) b.css:844 — change letter-spacing to var(--track-data) so "Ctrl Z" joins the register its six neighbours were moved to in round 6; 0.04em is on the declared TRACK ladder, so the ladder check stays clean. To close the blind spot permanently, do it in the artifact rather than in the shared gate: add a thirteenth state to elevate.config.json (e.g. "owner-undone") with a state builder in render-b.js beside states["owner-editing"] (render-b.js:1184) that opens the editor and pushes one history entry so the bar renders filled and visible on load. That puts .b-undoAct and .b-undo kbd inside the perimeter for every future round with no change to .claude/skills/elevate/scripts/audit.mjs, which guards other labs. Rebuild master via build.mjs; master is generated.
